itemized.notes: ⚠ A THIRD 2016 SCHEDULE-B TEMPLATE — the 2016 blanks were stocked INDEPENDENTLY, cover from schedules (addendum F6), and this filing proves it INSIDE one cycle and one seat. The cover here is the SAME blank Voeks 17bb61d5 used — 'FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES', 'Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5 & 20A-11-13', 'HEART of UTAH' mountain letterhead, inner sheets strap-lined '2016 County Commission & Local School Board Candidate' — but its SCHEDULE B COLUMN IS HEADED 'Expenditure', where Voeks's Schedule B on the same cover blank reuses Schedule A's 'Name of Contributor'. So in 2016 at least TWO Schedule-B sheets circulate under ONE cover blank (and a third, wholly different 'FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES' / Code 2-5-2 cover blank is in use in the same seat and cycle — see Frost 7dbce577). Neither schedule template prints a Purpose column in any variant seen so far. This cover also differs from Voeks's in its left-margin vertical text ('Local School & County Candidates' here, none there). 4 pages, all classified by their own printed headings: p1 cover, p2 SUMMARY PAGE, p3 SCHEDULE A, p4 SCHEDULE B. FOLIATION: the Page __ of __ / Last Name / Date of Report block is printed on pp2-4 and left WHOLLY BLANK on all three — another instance of the 'Page/of left blank' practice; page ordinals locate nothing and every page here was classified from its own header. PAGE-FACE NAME 'Jeanne Bowen', party Democrat, residence Provo UT; index.csv names NO candidate for this row, so the page face supplies it. Note the channel's own two labels for this filer differ across her 2016 filings ('Jeanne Bowen' vs 'Jeanie Bowen' on 950f13c0) — the page face governs. OFFICE SEEKING is written 'Commisson seat C' — the filer's own spelling, missing an 'i', reproduced verbatim and not corrected. AMENDMENT QUESTION LEFT WHOLLY UNANSWERED — neither 'Yes' nor 'No' is ticked (addendum A4: an honest BLANK, never read as 'No'). The report-type box 'Seven days preceding the General Election' is the only one marked. Date of report is written '31 Oct 2016' — day-month-year in words, unlike every other filing in this chunk. PRIVACY: this filing is NOT redacted; the filer wrote full street lines for every donor and vendor and they are published in the clear. Reduced to city/state at read time for contributions and dropped entirely for expenditures; no street line and no phone number reached this record. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN run on both sides — dates are dates, names are names, the address column holds addresses and the amount column holds money on all 9 rows; no inversion. Row-index traps: the §A1 and §B5 controls passed on both sheets; there is ONE continuation line (the Go Daddy address wrapping onto Schedule B band 6) and one in-band annotation ('Online' under the Home Depot address), neither of which shifts an index here because both sit at or after the last entry — but they are the live instances of trap F1.2 on this filer's hand.
